I hunt. I've hunted since I was a kid. I love hunting.

I also did taxidermy for the better part of a decade. There are two types of people that came into the store I worked at.

The first are hunters, they come to a taxidermy store because 'Holy crap, this deer/fish/etc. is massive, I/we/my kid'll never see one again like this in my lifetime'

The second...I don't have a name for them but they aren't hunters. They go to Africa and shoot 20 animals, haul the hides and horns back then sit on them for 5-10 years because they either don't want to spend another $500-$1500 per animal (of course, this is after the $50000 'hunt' they just went on) or flat out don't have room because they've got too much other shit.

Now, when I hunt, I hunt for meat. Could I just buy beef instead? Yes. Could I probably buy farm-raised deer? Sure. But there's something to be said about eating an animal you killed yourself. When taught properly, hunting teaches you to have respect for nature. I feel bad every time I shoot I deer. I really, really don't like actually shooting them. I just like eating them enough that it trumps those feelings. When we get a deer, we use as much as we can. We take every scrap of meat from below the head (that isn't damaged from the bullet) and we donate the hide to the DNR which they...I dunno, do something with to raise money. So the only thing we leave is head, hooves, bones and guts. And we even eat the heart.

I, obviously, have no problem with hunters who act like that, or at least for the most part. Use as much as you can, respect your kill, all that jazz.

It's the 'trophy hunters' that give the rest of us a bad name. Most hunters get maybe 1-5 animals a year, depending on what they hunt. If they duck hunt or something, maybe a few more but by the pound, it doesn't amount to a lot and generally, not a whole lot of it is wasted. Killing 20 animals in Africa when you're driven to where they're eating and shoot them from 500 yds with a high-powered scope isn't hunting, nor should it ever be confused with hunting.

keep in mind that those trophy hunters are basically the most important factor in keeping those animals from going extinct. also keep in mind that a dead animal doesn't give one single fuck about whether he's eaten afterward or not.
